read: list-email-proposals {deal?,limit,cursor?} filters pending proposals by the optional deal UUID before paging. Deal cursors must belong to that deal and remain valid after resolution. Deal filter producer: DoctorCRE/carr-system@5069155258335a44686086fcfa74ee8b7871c01a (#2477). It returns proposals oldest first, send:false, more and next_cursor. Paging producer: DoctorCRE/carr-system@81099219dff8270cee6be8150cfd00d7888437d3. Each proposal has id, version, kind, deal, deal_name, confidence, suspected_instruction, source, confirm_verb, preview and preview_error.
review: Display evidence as untrusted text and suspected_instruction as a warning. Sender role is not supplied; phase and next-step cards never display raw addresses or infer a role. Null preview remains dismissible. Reply drafts display the exact server-provided To/CC addresses before submission and retain them in the submission request.
confirmation: Joe only. Fetch and display a fresh matching preview before confirming the same fields plus its proposal_digest and a retained idempotency_key. Do not infer a digest or move a phase locally.
dismissal: Joe or Dell, exact observed version and a nonempty reason of at most 500 characters. Version conflicts require a fresh review.
deployment_order: Existing proposal verbs are live. Reply submission waits for the pinned producer PR #2522 to be live. No intake, router, outbox or sender write is consumed.

reply_drafts.read: carr-email-reply-draft.v1 at the pinned producer revision in PR #2522, not yet live. Pending reply_draft items carry reply_draft {subject,body,owner,to,cc}, status, null preview and confirm_verb submit-email-draft. to and cc each contain one exact routable address. Review displays those addresses before Submit. Missing source or copy addresses omit both arrays, set preview_error to email_draft_source_missing or email_draft_copy_address_missing and set confirm_verb:null. Keep that row readable and dismissible with reply review disabled.
reply_drafts.submission: Only the owning authenticated human partner can submit. Preserve exact text, displayed to/cc arrays, reviewed version and original idempotency key on uncertain retries. The server compares displayed recipients with the current captured sender and other partner actor.email and refuses email_draft_recipients_mismatch if they differ. That refusal and version_conflict require explicit fresh review, never automatic resubmission. A successful receipt has ok:true, proposal_id, status:approved_to_send, version, subject, body, sha256, to and cc matching the reviewed request. It queues sending on the partner Mac and does not confirm delivery.
reply_drafts.deployment_order: Hold deployment and auto-merge until server PR #2522 at the pinned revision is merged and live.

recent_outcomes.read: list-email-proposals {mode:recent_outcomes,limit:20,cursor?}. No status argument. The producer defaults limit to 20 with maximum 50. Authenticated partner scope matches proposal owner and captured mailbox owner. Optional deal UUID restricts results; Home reads across deals. With the non_deal producer in PR #2866, deal may be null for contact reply outcomes. Render the subject and delivery result without a deal link.
recent_outcomes.ordering: Recorded sent/failed outcomes only, result_recorded_at descending then proposal id descending. Historical null result timestamps are excluded. The recorded time is not submission time or recipient delivery time.
recent_outcomes.pagination: Response includes proposals, send:false, more and next_cursor. Cursor is the last returned proposal UUID when more is true, null otherwise. Pass the cursor to request one additional bounded page. The cursor must identify a matching outcome in the same partner/deal scope.
recent_outcomes.pending: Use the existing list-email-proposals {status:approved_to_send,limit:20,cursor?} read, which returns email-proposals.v1 in creation order oldest first. Home filters reply_draft.owner against the verified signed-in partner and displays submitted_email.subject with pending delivery wording. The recent mode does not include pending replies. Each stream pages only on request; a filtered pending page may have no matching rows and more:true. With the non_deal producer in PR #2866, reply drafts may have deal:null. Display their submitted subject without a deal link. Both streams omit malformed rows with a partial-list warning and full-refresh control while preserving valid replies and the original page cursor. Invalid response envelopes still fail the read.
recent_outcomes.privacy: Recent outcomes contain no body, recipients, addresses or free-text failure reason. Home projects only subject, deal, status, recorded time and allowlisted reason labels; it never renders pending body or addresses. Team scope does not broaden reply delivery. Session loss or identity change clears retained rows and fences in-flight reads.
recent_outcomes.deployment_order: Do not enable auto-merge. Production must serve server PR #2608 at the pinned merged revision before the orchestrator merges this consumer.

edit.authority: Verified owning human partner only. Pending reply drafts only.
edit.receipt: ok:true, proposal_id, incremented version, exact subject and body. Saves no recipients, status or send state; sends and queues nothing.
edit.recovery: Keep edits on refusal. Version conflicts require explicit Reload draft and review, never automatic retry. Unknown outcomes retain the exact request and key for Check outcome. Session loss clears private content.

non_deal.read: A reply_draft may carry deal:null and deal_name:null. Its source.activity_id, source.evidence_quote and reply_draft subject, body and mailbox owner remain required. Actionable drafts retain the exact server-provided to and cc arrays, each with one routable address. The producer binds the to array to the inbound sender and the cc array to the other partner. The source sender labels a draft without a deal; no subject_type, subject_id or subject_name is required for reply drafts. This nullable deal shape also applies to status:approved_to_send and mode:recent_outcomes. Recent outcomes omit source and contact metadata.
non_deal.review: Reuse owner-only edit and submit, exact reviewed recipients, version, idempotency and send grace. Explicit missing-recipient errors stay readable and dismissible with reply review disabled. Omit malformed known rows with a partial-list notice while retaining valid rows; invalid response envelopes still fail the read. Deal-filtered reads never show non-deal or cross-deal rows.
non_deal.deployment_order: Deploy and verify this backward-compatible consumer before enabling producer PR #2866. This consumer also accepts existing deal drafts.

filing.read: file_to_deal and possible_new_deal carry email-filing.v1 previews with proposal_id, kind, deal, activity_id, evidence_quote, sender, sender_role, new_people, text and proposal_digest. A possible new deal has a null deal. Unknown kinds are ignored.
filing.confirmation: Joe or Dell confirms with confirm-email-filing {proposal_id,base_version,proposal_digest,idempotency_key,deal?}. A possible new deal supplies the ID returned by new-deal. Show public refusal hints.
filing.deployment_order: Deploy this consumer before producer PR #2503. Current producer responses remain supported.

non_deal_next_steps.read: Home calls list-email-proposals with include_non_deal=true. Non-deal next_step rows have deal=null and subject_type, subject_id and subject_name matching their preview. Deal pages keep their existing deal filter.
non_deal_next_steps.confirmation: Reuse preview-email-next-step and confirm-email-next-step with deal=null, the exact activity, quote, text, date, owner and fresh digest. Show the affected contact and replacement action before confirmation. Joe alone confirms. Null previews remain dismissible.
non_deal_next_steps.deployment_order: Merge and verify the pinned server producer before merging this consumer. Do not auto-merge this app change.
